lessons.trigger_condition: an automated grading-company watch has write authority and publishes collected output directly to main, or main advances after collection before publication
lessons.symptom_summary: validated provider data can bypass the repository PR/check path or a stale snapshot can race a newer main revision
lessons.fix_pattern: publish only to a candidate branch, fail closed on main SHA drift, regenerate and diagnose integrity metadata, and merge only after the required protected-main checks pass

lessons.trigger_condition: tablet feature updates rely on a 24-hour or hourly relative sleep loop instead of the requested daily 23:00 KST schedule, or install only prepares boot wiring without a live current-session loop
lessons.symptom_summary: the tablet can remain on an older main longer than intended or run updates at a drifting clock time
lessons.fix_pattern: compute the next absolute 23:00 KST run, maintain one PID-tracked live loop, start it during install/ensure, preserve Termux:Boot supervision, and re-ensure scheduling after manual update-now

lessons.trigger_condition: verified tablet packages and receipts accumulate without a bounded retention policy, or cleanup is implemented with broad wildcard or purge semantics
lessons.symptom_summary: Drive storage can grow without bound or a cleanup routine can risk deleting user or unknown files
lessons.fix_pattern: retain bounded recent TCG-managed package and receipt sets, match only exact managed filename patterns, delete per file only after upload/read-back verification, preserve unknown files, and report cleanup failure separately from package validity
